title: Golden Diva with Gun
description: A woman in a shiny gold catsuit and curly updo stands confidently in a dramatic spotlight, holding a golden pistol in one hand with the other on her hip. She poses amid torn propaganda posters on a purple wall, with film reels and broken glass scattered on the wooden floor.
prompt: A confident woman with curly dark hair wearing a tight shiny metallic gold catsuit and black neck scarf stands in a dramatic pose holding a golden pistol in her right hand with her left hand on her hip, standing in a strong yellow spotlight beam against a dark purple wall with torn vintage propaganda posters including text like GOLDEN STASIS and SUS, broken glass and film reel on the wooden floor, cinematic retro aesthetic
